issue.title: [ORG-WIDE] Protocol Handoff & Routing Layer Alignment (2026-07-15)
issue.body:
## Summary

Cross-repo alignment following org-wide research. Conxian-Labs should own infrastructure only, not the protocol. Community should own the protocol to reduce regulatory risk.

## Strategic Direction

Per Core Directive #7: **Protocol Handoff** — The Conxian protocol/DeFi system creates regulatory risks for Conxian-Labs. **Community should own the protocol**.

## Org Repo Status (2026-07-15)

| Repo | Version | Status | Key Capabilities |
|------|---------|--------|------------------|
| `conxius-enclave-sdk` | v2.0.12 | ✅ Production | FROST DKG, BitVM2, Fedimint, Ark, MuSig2 |
| `lib-conxian-core` | v0.2.12 | ✅ Stable | Babylon/Fedimint adapters, BIP-110, Trust tiers |
| `conxian-gateway` | Active | ✅ Active | Routing middleware, ISO 20022 |
| `conxian-nexus` | Active | ✅ Active | Glass Node proof layer |
| `conxius-platform` | v0.2.5 | ✅ Active | Control plane, admin dashboard |

## Routing Layer Architecture

```
User/Protocol
     ↓
conxius-platform (control plane) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
conxian-gateway (routing) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
conxius-enclave-sdk (signing) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
Protocol (community-owned) ← Community owns this
```


## Action Items

### conxius-platform (this repo)
- [x] Core Directive #6: Routing Only
- [x] Core Directive #7: Protocol Handoff
- [ ] Update AGENTS.md with org repo status
- [ ] Define protocol handoff process

### conxian-gateway
- [ ] Verify sBTC routing integration
- [x] BIP-110 evaluation (#245)
- [ ] OP_CAT research needed

### conxius-enclave-sdk
- [x] Production ready at v2.0.12
- [ ] No action needed

### lib-conxian-core
- [x] BIP-110 alignment added
- [x] Chain adapters stable
- [ ] No action needed

### Protocol Handoff
- [ ] Define community-owned protocol structure
- [ ] Transfer DeFi contracts to community
- [ ] Update legal/regulatory docs

## Related Issues

- #1164 (revenue-automation) - spec only, community implementation
- conxian-gateway #245 (BIP-110 routing)
- conxius-enclave-sdk #179 (BIP-110 feature)

## Labels

protocol-handoff, routing-layer, org-wide, strategic

## Gateway Verification Hardening — 2026-08-07

Supporting the protocol handoff strategy, the gateway has strengthened independent verification across all settlement rails:

### Completed (PRs #325, #326)
- **9 adapter verify_state_proof implementations hardened** from rehearsal/shadow-mode to real cryptographic or structural validation
- **7 of 10 adapters** now perform real verification (Babylon EOTS, Fedimint guardian sigs, sBTC L1 proof, etc.)
- **0 TODOs** in the Rust codebase (only 1 remains: Fedimint native invite code)
- **352 tests** passing with clippy 0 warnings

### Verification Independence
The gateway can now independently verify on-chain state without trusting any single API or endpoint:
- Babylon: BIP340 Schnorr EOTS verification against finality provider keys
- Fedimint: Chaumian blind signature verification against guardian pubkeys
- sBTC: Bitcoin L1 transaction ID and block header proof-of-work verification
- Rootstock: BTC transaction SHA256d matching
- ISO 20022: pacs.008 XML generation + CAMT XSD structural validation

This reduces dependency on centralized bridge endpoints and supports the protocol handoff narrative of community-owned verification.

### Cross-repo alignment
- BitVM2 Groth16 verification: gateway boundary types ready, awaiting SDK implementation (conxius-enclave-sdk #267)
- SDK signing adapters defined in `conxian-core`, awaiting wire-up (conxius-enclave-sdk #271)

issue.title: Resolve Visibility Boundary Documentation Gap and Harden Multi-Layered Gitignores
issue.body:
This security-first improvement pass addresses key organizational risks regarding public/private visibility boundaries and accidental config/artifact exposure by:
1. Enumerating repository-by-repository visibility decisions for the private boundaries of conxian-business and .github-private in the canonical Repository Taxonomy register (resolving CON-324 documentation gap).
2. Hardening and aligning local .gitignore configurations across all three monorepo services to consistently and multi-layeredly ignore sensitive .env* files, runtime playwright/test reports, and built outputs.
3. Successfully verifying all changes with the built-in system_audit.py and the full Node and Python unit/integration test suites (all 249 tests passing).

issue.title: Stale branch review — 2026-08
issue.body:
## Stale branch review — 2026-08-01

Automated monthly branch maintenance review per [BRANCH-MAINTENANCE.md](https://github.com/Conxian/conxius-platform/blob/main/docs/BRANCH-MAINTENANCE.md).

### :wastebasket: Deletion candidates (>180 days inactive)

These branches have had no activity in over 180 days and are candidates for deletion:

- `origin` (last commit: 1970-01-01)

### Next steps

- Review each branch above and decide to **keep** (add a comment with expected timeline) or **delete**
- Delete a branch: `git push origin --delete <branch>`
- Archive before deleting: `git tag archive/<branch> origin/<branch> && git push origin --delete <branch> && git push origin archive/<branch>`

issue.title: Enforce org-wide GitHub rulesets and push protection
issue.body:
Live-only verification issue for GitHub controls.

Verified date: 2026-07-04.

This issue should remain open until settings-level proof is attached. Current repo-content inspection shows strong governance baselines in several public repositories, but that does not prove org-level enforcement.

Scope:

* org rulesets or equivalent protections
* required pull-request review requirements
* required status checks
* branch protection on priority public repos
* push protection and secret-scanning posture where available
* dependency-review coverage on dependency-changing pull requests
* explicit repo-level exceptions

Priority repos for verification:

* `.github`
* `Conxian`
* `conxius-wallet`
* `conxian-gateway`
* `conxian-nexus`
* `lib-conxian-core`
* `conxius-platform`
* `conxius-enclave-sdk`
* `conxian_ui`
* `conxian-labs-site`

Additional verification emphasis from the latest package/release review:

* verify that release-bearing repos are not protected only in advisory / `evaluate` mode where blocking enforcement is expected
* verify that rulesets and branch protection are active on the repos currently serving as public developer or package surfaces
* verify push protection / secret scanning coverage specifically on repos shipping packages, SDKs, wallet artifacts, or gateway release flows
* verify that exceptions are explicit and justified rather than accidental gaps left after release work

Live-only rule:

Do not close this from documentation or repo-file presence alone. Close it only when settings-level evidence is captured repo by repo or org wide.

## Weekly execution alignment — 2026-07-25

This issue remains the main organization-level governance verification issue for the current market push.

Priority order for the coming week:
1. Verify settings-level truth on the priority repos listed above.
2. Record which protections are blocking vs advisory.
3. Record any explicit exceptions so release-bearing repos are not left in ambiguous policy states.

Control rule:
- repo-file governance is no longer the main question; settings-level enforcement is.

issue.body:
The unified CI workflow references validation scripts with `hashFiles()` guards, but the following scripts are not present in `scripts/`, so the checks are silently skipped instead of enforcing policy:

* `scripts/verify_knowledge_retention.py`
* `scripts/verify_tracked_artifacts.py`
* `scripts/verify_compose_env_templates.py`
* `scripts/verify_submodule_secret_filenames.py`
* `scripts/verify_bos_production_boundary.py`
* `scripts/verify_contamination_guard.py`
* `scripts/verify_pr_bos_classification.py`
* `scripts/verify_release_hygiene.py`

Implement the missing scripts or remove the workflow references so CI reflects the intended validation coverage.
